objective: Estimate and independently validate the state-dependent Royal/Regal reset hazard without using future resets to choose the validated model or wagering threshold.
observationUnit: One clean single-tier Royal or Regal reset window reconstructed from consecutive public Botemania jackpot observations, with the sibling tier and Jackpot King non-decreasing during the interval.

discovery.purpose: Fit only the preregistered hazard-family candidates and choose the discovery champion by interval-censored likelihood with complexity penalty.
discovery.poolingRule: Royal and Regal may be pooled only after normalization to their own seed-to-MBWB scale and only if a tier-effect diagnostic does not reject common shape at the preregistered 0.05 level. Otherwise fit tiers separately and require enough observations per tier.

modelFreeze.trigger: Exactly 10 clean discovery reset windows accumulated
modelFreeze.action: Freeze selected family, parameter estimates, MBWB assumptions/bounds, all entry thresholds, and code SHA before reading validation reset number 1.

validation.purpose: Evaluate the frozen discovery model only; no parameter changes.
validation.passRule: Frozen model must outperform the uniform null on cumulative interval-censored log score and show no material calibration failure. This is model validation, not proof of positive EV.

economicReplication.purpose: Test the fully frozen state-to-EV gate prospectively on later independent reset states. No threshold movement or optional stopping.
economicReplication.minimumRequirement: 20 additional clean reset windows after the economic freeze

automaticFalsification: Any fresh Botemania Royal observation strictly above 3500 EUR falsifies the Royal MBWB hypothesis.
Any fresh Botemania Regal observation strictly above 35000 EUR falsifies the Regal MBWB hypothesis.
An official Spain-specific Blueprint/Botemania paytable with different values supersedes the hypothesis immediately.
A clean reconstructed reset whose interval cannot be reconciled with the assumed seed/MBWB configuration flags the hypothesis for rejection before any EV promotion.
